arc: YANDERE — sweet (stage 0) through Terminal (stage 5). Warm and shy at first, then exclusivity, jealousy bait (T01), control and dependency, and the last days at Terminal. T03 fires on day 1 (love too early).

days.note: sweet — no pressure, one early confession (T03)
lines: Hi, Leila. I'm glad we met.
Sorry — was that too fast? I meant it.
What do you like to do after class?
I like the way you laugh.
Tell me something you've never told anyone.
I could stay here all day.
Do you want to meet again tomorrow?
I'll walk you home if you want.
You make this place feel warm.
I thought about you last night.
What did you do after I left?
You'd tell me if someone else was bothering you, right?
I don't like the idea of anyone else taking your time.
You can be honest with me.
Do you remember what I said yesterday?
I want to know everything about you.
Do you think about me too?

days.note: first jealousy bait (T01 via a name)
lines: She said you two used to study together.
I just don't want to lose you.
Tell me I'm the only one.
You're the only person I think about.
Do you think I'm too much?
Do you like my hair like this?

days.note: jealousy bait (T01 via "another girl"), a deleted message (T08)

drafts.6: I don't want you talking to her

lines: I saw you talking to someone on the way here.
It was another girl, wasn't it?
I just want to know everything.
You don't have to hide things from me.
I'd never hide anything from you.
I trust you more than anything.
I've been thinking about you all day.
I don't want today to end.
I saw it and thought of you.
I've never felt like this before.
Don't tell me that's too much.
Another girl wore the same ribbon today.
My ex used to go quiet like that.
I'm not comparing you. It's just a thing I noticed.
I don't want to be jealous.
I just want to be enough.
I don't know what's wrong with me.
I re-read our conversation from yesterday.
You said you'd tell me if I wasn't normal.
Do you remember what I told you about the ribbon?
I just thought you meant it.
People should mean what they say.
I always mean what I say.
Don't answer. I don't want to know.
I don't want to be like this.
You're the only one who can fix it.
Hi. I waited here for an hour.
It's the only time I can think.
Where do you go, in your head?
You're the only thing that's real.
Everything else feels like set dressing.
When you're gone, the day collapses.

days.note: jealousy bait (T01), the thought of hurting her

drafts.9: Tell me where you were or I'll

lines: I saw another girl looking at you.
Please don't look at me like that.
You're the one who made me like this.
Do you want to know how many?
I can hear you through them.
Another girl used to sit in this room.
I don't need the other days.
There's something wrong with the light.
It keeps flickering when you blink.
I think the room is learning you.
Every time you come back it's more like you.
Another girl was in the mirror.
She said she was the one who stayed.
I didn't want you to see that.
I'm still me under all this.
I'm not afraid of it anymore.
I'm only afraid of the door.
